content: {"paper_id":"W2028851602","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"multi-label-learning","exact_quote":"The proposed preference distribution learning (PDL) method is applied to the problem of multilabel ranking for natural scene images.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"论文将PDL应用于多标记排序问题，属于多标记学习任务。"},{"keyword_id":"label-distribution-learning","exact_quote":"The key idea is to learn a latent preference distribution for each instance.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"核心是学习每个实例的潜在偏好分布，即对标签的相对偏好程度，符合标签分布学习核心任务。"},{"keyword_id":"label-correlation-modeling","exact_quote":"The first step is to generate a common preference distribution that is most compatible to all the personal rankings.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"从多个个人标签排序生成共同偏好分布，显式建模标签间的排序/偏好关系。"},{"keyword_id":"weakly-supervised-learning","exact_quote":"While most existing multilabel ranking methods assume the availability of a single objective label ranking for each instance in the training set, this paper deals with a more common case where subjective inconsistent rankings from multiple rankers are associated with each instance.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"训练监督并非单一客观标签排序，而是多个排序者的主观不一致排序，论文以该不准确/不一致监督为研究问题。"}],"abstentions":[{"keyword_id":"noisy-label-learning","reason_zh":"摘要仅说明多个排序者给出主观不一致排序，未明确这些排序含错误类别标签或不准确标签分布，无法确定属于噪声标签学习。"}],"input_issues":[]}
